summary: Cheque dishonor case under S.138 Negotiable Instruments Act; admitted cheque signature triggers S.139 presumption of legal debt; respondent failed to rebut presumption through evidence; High Court erred in relying on Rangappa v. Sri Mohan for preponderance test; loan agreement validity contested; IT returns scrutiny insufficient to negate debt; reversal warranted on legal principles.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; acquittal set aside; conviction and sentence reinstated under S.138 NI Act.
